description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying its mana cost.
When Blood Pet enters, Metastatic Evangel triggers.
Holding priority, activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
